_comment: Authoritative site data, read at startup by SiteCatalog and applied OVER the inspector.
The only inspector field that selects a site is GeospatialController.siteId.
Coordinates to 6+ decimal places, from Google Earth Pro or a survey, not a phone GPS.
adjustments.json on the device is a per-user refinement on top of this baseline, and a
save made on site can overwrite these coordinates for that siteId until 'clear saved'.

buildings.name: Synagogue
_notes: cornerA is on the FACADE, cornerB is the BACK corner (as pinned in Google Earth),
so the pair runs front-to-back: 41.19 m apart on bearing 141.95 deg true.
Heading therefore = 141.95 + 180 = 321.95, the facade looking north-west, and the
scale fits the model's DEPTH (BuildingLoader footprintAxis = Z) to 41.19 m.
headingDeg here is a record of what the corners derive, not an input.
